name: beacon_score
description: Measure how tightly a series of event times clusters around its median interval: the median interval, the median absolute deviation and mad_over_median, a descriptive shape (tight_cluster, clustered, loose_cluster, dispersed; the cut-offs are conventions of this tool, not properties of any implant), event_density_ratio (distinct events over the count a constant schedule at the median would give; below 1 is not evidence that events are missing), duplicate times counted apart from distinct events, and every interval kept (a bounded page inline, the whole list in a file the answer names). A regular series is not malicious (update checks, telemetry, NTP and monitoring are more regular than most malware) and an irregular one says nothing about a destination: a score is a measurement, not a verdict. long_final_gap reports a last interval over four times the median that ended in an observed event; it is not a cessation. A statement about silence after the last event is made only when window_end and sensor_coverage_confirmed are both given, and is a bounded negative about this series. A time with no zone is refused unless assume_utc is true (and each such value is counted); NaN, infinite or non-epoch-second values are counted and named, never scored. The series is what the caller supplied: this tool does not read captures or logs.

timestamps.description: Event times: epoch seconds, or ISO 8601 strings that carry a zone. Give this or timestamps_file

timestamps_file.description: A file with one time per line (for a series too long to pass inline); the same value rules apply

label.description: What this series is, carried into the result

min_events.description: Refuse to score fewer than this many distinct events (default 6, at least 3)

assume_utc.description: Read a time with no zone as UTC (default false: such a time is refused). Every time read this way is counted in naive_timestamps_assumed_utc

window_end.description: When the sensor's coverage of this series ends (epoch seconds or ISO 8601 with a zone). Needed, with sensor_coverage_confirmed, before anything is said about silence after the last event

sensor_coverage_confirmed.description: True only when you know the sensor kept recording over the whole window up to window_end

limit.description: Intervals shown inline (default 40); the whole list is written under $OUT/tool-output (work/<agent>/tool-output outside a job) and named in intervals_page

out_dir.description: Optional empty directory under work/ (in a job, under $OUT) for intervals.tsv, every interval with its two times
